svg.title: Proposed AWS production architecture
svg.desc: Internet users reach an AWS WAF protected load balancer in public subnets. It routes to proposed configurator and instrumentation ECS Fargate services in private application subnets. Instrumentation polls the configurator privately. Both services access an Aurora PostgreSQL cluster in isolated database subnets. The configurator and physical devices exchange messages through AWS IoT Core. Subnets span two Availability Zones. Integration and scaling require application changes.
svg.text: Not implemented · private tiers and multiple AZs require application changes
VPC · at least two Availability Zones
Private application subnets · ECS services on Fargate
Tasks distributed across AZs only after state and ingestion are safe to replicate
NAT / VPC endpoints, DNS, secrets, logging and certificate management omitted.
